gramlot-js-server 0.2.7 follows the core 0.2.12: the core `Host` is now `GramlotServer`, and the server protocol GC-230 is checked on this adapter. The three packages require `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.12 or later.

## Changes

- API
  - The core names: `GramlotServer`, `GramlotFileServer`, `ServerCapacity`, the entry `@gramlot/gramlot/gramlot-server`. The old names have no aliases.
  - `startServer` returns `{gramlotServer, server, url, close}`: `gramlotServer` is the core `GramlotServer` (it was `host`), `server` stays the `http.Server` or `Bun.Server`.
  - `createDispatch` takes the option `server` (it was `host`) and returns `{server, prefix, fetch}`.
  - Serverless: `WorkerHost` is `GramlotWorkerServer`, in `src/gramlot-worker-server.js`; the entry `./worker-host` is `./gramlot-worker-server`.
  - `close()` of `startServer` empties the page registry with the core `closeAll()`.
  - The runtime at `/assets/gramlot.js` is the file chosen by the core `runtimeAsset()`: `gramlot.min.js`, or `gramlot.js` with `GRAMLOT_DEV=DEBUG`. `GRAMLOT_DEV` also sets the default of the `GramlotFileServer` option `reload`, which the adapter passes through.
  - Source methods are marked with `Page.registerSource('name')`; the free function `source(...)` is gone from the core, from `GramlotStandalone` and from the serverless exports.
- `@gramlot/create`
  - The templates and the gallery page `serverless-02` call `gramlot.utl.inout` (it was `gramlot.inout`, moved by the core 0.2.10).
  - The generated `package.json` requires `@gramlot/gramlot` `>=0.2.12`.
  - The generated `package.json` requires `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server` and `@gramlot/gramlot-serverless` `>=` the version of `@gramlot/create`, without a caret: first-party dependencies are never capped.
- Tests
  - `server/test/server.test.mjs` runs the core `checkProtocol` (GC-230) on the quick-start pages, without a prefix and with `/app` and a Content Security Policy, on Node and Bun.
  - The tests and the browser scripts use the client proxies of the core 0.2.10: `app.src.source`, `app.src.builder`, `app.src.renderer`, `app.src.remoteSource`, `app.rpc.transport`.
  - The gallery checks run against `@gramlot/gramlot-examples` 0.2.9; the optional peer dependency requires 0.2.9 or later, the first release for the core 0.2.12.
- Documentation
  - The guides use `GramlotServer`, `GramlotFileServer` and `GramlotWorkerServer`; the configuration documents `reload` and `GRAMLOT_DEV`.

## Verified

Node.js 23.11 and Bun 1.3.14, with the published core 0.2.12, `@genrojs/builders` 0.4.2 and `@gramlot/gramlot-examples` 0.2.9: the tests of the three packages (server 15 on Node and 15 on Bun, serverless 32, create 3); in Chromium 153 the server checks on Node and Bun, the exported files (hello world, Source live, inline code), the Worker sentinel of the core checkout, the quick start and the page module, the gallery from disk (34 examples), the gallery on Node and Bun under `/js` (33 examples) and the templates of `@gramlot/create`.
